units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 2b:10">B. Kam. 2ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Exodus 21:28">Ex. XXI, 28</cite>) <he>אין נ׳ אלא בקרן</he> the root <he>נגח</he> refers to injury by the horn, contrad. to <cite ref="N00164"><he>נגיפה</he></cite> collision of bodies.
Ib. האי נגיפה נ׳ היא that nagaf (Ex. XXI, 35) means injury through goring. Y. ib. I, beg. 2ᵃ. Mekh. Mishp., s. 12; a. fr.
